description: Pass/fail thresholds for the threading stress scenarios (sub-issue #172). Latency bounds assume a release build on the dev machine; the bench runner in benches/threading.rs enforces these. A PR that regresses a bound must update it here with justification.

wake_coalescing.note: The actor already coalesces at the read-batch level, so the content-dirty gate is a second, cadence-dependent layer whose publish:wake ratio scales with render-vs-publish rate. The enforced invariant is wakes < generations and wakes <= max_wakes; the issue's aspirational 100:1 assumes raw per-signal publishes, which this architecture does not emit.
